regions.content: Distant rolling grassland hills under a warm cream sky on the left side; soft hazy silhouettes of trees on the far horizon.
Continuation of the rolling hills on the right with a slightly taller hill profile; the sky brightens subtly toward the upper right.

layers.palette: warm cream sky, hazy blue-green distant hills, soft golden horizon

regions.content: Mid-distance grassland with scattered trees and bushes on the left, including a small grove that frames the play area.
Mid-distance grassland on the right with one or two larger trees and a hint of a small water pond peeking through.

layers.palette: saturated grass-green, leafy mid-tone trees, muted earth shadows

regions.content: Foreground grass tufts, a winding dirt path entering from the left, and a small rock cluster framing the path edge.
Foreground grass with a tree stump on the right, the dirt path winding off-screen, and scattered flower spots near the bottom edge.

layers.palette: vivid foreground grass, warm dirt path browns, accent flower colors

tilesheet.shared_palette: vivid grass-green, warm dirt brown, cool water blue, neutral grey rock — top-down view consistent across all tiles

tiles.edges: Uniform grass texture across all four edges so it tiles seamlessly with itself and other grass-base tiles.
tiles.description: Plain grass field tile (top-down view) with subtle blade variation.

tiles.edges: Edges match plain grass exactly so flowers sit interior to the cell; no flowers cross the tile border.

tiles.description: Dirt path with grass on the northeast corner — for a path turning toward the northeast.

tiles.edges: Top and left edges are grass; bottom and right edges are dirt — the dirt forms a quarter-arc cornering northwest.
tiles.description: Dirt path with grass on the northwest corner.

tiles.edges: Bottom and right edges are grass; top and left edges are dirt — the dirt forms a quarter-arc cornering southeast.
tiles.description: Dirt path with grass on the southeast corner.

tiles.edges: Bottom and left edges are grass; top and right edges are dirt — the dirt forms a quarter-arc cornering southwest.

tiles.edges: All four edges are uniform water texture so it tiles with itself; the subtle wave pattern is interior.

tiles.description: Water meeting grass — shoreline transition tile.

tiles.edges: All four edges match plain grass; the tree stump is centered interior to the tile and does not cross the border.
